description: This file implements a GStreamer source element class 'GstRialtoSrc' for the Rialto media framework, including methods for handling URI management, message processing, state changes, and setup of media pipelines with optional DRM and payloader components. It also includes factory methods for creating and managing instances of the source object within the Rialto server environment.

classes.name: GstRialtoSrc
classes.description: A custom GStreamer source element class for Rialto, handling media streaming, URI management, and message processing.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcDispose
methods.description: Disposes of the GstRialtoSrc object, calling parent class dispose.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the GstRialtoSrc object, freeing resources.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcSetProperty
methods.description: Sets a property on the GstRialtoSrc object, delegating to parent class.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetProperty
methods.description: Gets a property from the GstRialtoSrc object, delegating to parent class.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcUriGetType
methods.description: Returns the URI type handled by this element, which is 'source'.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetProtocols
methods.description: Returns the protocols supported by this URI handler, which is 'rialto'.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcGetUri
methods.description: Retrieves the current URI of the source element.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcSetUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the source element, only allowed in states below PAUSED.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcUriHandlerInit
methods.description: Initializes the URI handler interface with function pointers.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcQueryWithParent
methods.description: Forwards queries to the target pad if available.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcHandleMessage
methods.description: Handles messages sent to the source bin, particularly EOS, and emits appropriate signals.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcDoAsyncStart
methods.description: Starts asynchronous processing, sending an async start message.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcDoAsyncDone
methods.description: Completes asynchronous processing, sending an async done message.

methods.name: gstRialtoSrcChangeState
methods.description: Handles state changes, managing async start/stop as needed.

methods.name: gst_rialto_src_init
methods.description: Initializes a GstRialtoSrc instance, setting default values.

methods.name: gst_rialto_src_class_init
methods.description: Sets up class methods and properties for GstRialtoSrc.

methods.name: GstSrc::initSrc
methods.description: Initializes the source element, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: GstSrc::setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Configures and adds appsrc, decryptor, payloader, and queue elements to the pipeline.

methods.name: GstSrc::allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Indicates all appsrc pads have been added and completes async setup.

methods.name: GstSrc::createPayloader
methods.description: Creates a payloader element, specifically 'svppay'.
